note: Owner-curated. Each entry cites one rule. The build fails if the rule does not exist or is no longer marked as a Redux deviation. kind is one of switchable, always_on, helper, look, fix. `setting` names the Configure option that restores the original, if any.

differences.title: Slimes and Gargoyles split once
differences.original: A surviving Slime or Gargoyle can divide again and again, and so can its children.
differences.redux: Each splits once at most, and its child cannot split.

differences.title: A stat award for every level
differences.original: A visit from the Wanderer gives one +1 to STR, DEX or INT, even if you gained several levels at once.
differences.redux: You get one award for each level gained, and none if a level is corrected downward.

differences.title: Camp on horseback or a carpet
differences.original: The party must be on foot to camp.
differences.redux: Horses stay mounted. A magic carpet goes into your pack while you rest.

differences.title: Sails come down when a fight starts
differences.original: Sail state and sailing direction carry on after the fight.
differences.redux: Every fight furls the sails, so you choose when to sail on. Your heading is kept.

differences.title: The party remembers chests
differences.original: Each Search rolls again, and a failed search invents how bad a trap is.
differences.redux: What you learn about a chest lasts the visit, and Jimmy will not waste a key on one you know is safe.

differences.title: Located moonstones are marked for you
differences.original: The Sextant reports where you stand.
differences.redux: Locating a moonstone also marks it for navigation, at no extra cost or time.

differences.title: Gates you cannot see change quietly
differences.original: Every gate rises and sinks silently.
differences.redux: A gate in view animates with a message. One out of sight changes at once and never stops you.

differences.title: Cannon shots stop at walls
differences.original: The inspected cannon code can remove a target behind a wall, and its Shadowlord exclusion has no effect.
differences.redux: Shots stop at blocking terrain, and cannons cannot remove Shadowlords.

differences.title: Sextant, day or night
differences.original: The Sextant works on the world map, at night.
differences.redux: Day or night, on the world map and inside surface towns. A Sextant is still required, and dungeons and the Underworld are still excluded.

differences.title: Unlit dungeons show dim outlines
differences.original: With no light, the dungeon view is black.
differences.redux: Dim geometry shows, but you gain no light.
